cards.title: Lifting & Mechanical Rigging Failure (Dropped Load) — During BOP stack installation on Moran Rig-04, the primary winch cable displayed severe wire strand fraying and unlatched secondary safety hook.
cards.description: Quote: "primary winch cable displayed severe wire strand fraying and unlatched secondary safety hook" | Failed Barrier: Certified Lifting Slings & Drop Zone Exclusion Barricade | Observation: During BOP stack installation on Moran Rig-04, the primary winch cable displayed severe wire strand fraying and unlatched secondary safety hook.
cards.observation: During BOP stack installation on Moran Rig-04, the primary winch cable displayed severe wire strand fraying and unlatched secondary safety hook.
cards.failed_barrier: Certified Lifting Slings & Drop Zone Exclusion Barricade
cards.evidence_quote: primary winch cable displayed severe wire strand fraying and unlatched secondary safety hook
llmSuggestions: Immediately ground suspended load and barricade 1.5x crane swing drop-zone with high-visibility safety tape.
Perform thorough visual inspection on wire rope slings, shackles, and load hooks for elongation, kinks, or missing safety latches.
Re-verify Critical Lift Plan calculation sheet and ensure banksman / rigger certification is current before any further lift.

cards.title: 2000psi Hydrocarbon Gas / Vapor (Flammable/Toxic) — a worker is working in 2000psi pipeline and went into confined space and there is no electricity
cards.description: Quote: "Worker entered 2000psi pipeline in Confined Space without Multi-Gas Atmospheric Testing or Confined Space Attendant" | Failed Barrier: Confined Space Entry Permit, Multi-Gas Atmospheric Testing & Standby Attendant | Observation: a worker is working in 2000psi pipeline and went into confined space and there is no electricity
cards.observation: a worker is working in 2000psi pipeline and went into confined space and there is no electricity
cards.failed_barrier: Confined Space Entry Permit, Multi-Gas Atmospheric Testing & Standby Attendant
cards.evidence_quote: Worker entered 2000psi pipeline in Confined Space without Multi-Gas Atmospheric Testing or Confined Space Attendant
llmSuggestions: Evacuate non-essential personnel upwind to designated muster point and verify fixed detector loop telemetry with central control room.
Deploy portable multi-gas detector survey to establish 10 ppm H2S exclusion zone prior to manual maintenance authorization.
Require Type-C positive pressure SCBA apparatus for entry and verify calibration certificates of gas detection instrumentation.
